profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer at Booz Allen Hamilton
profile.summary: Result-oriented software engineer with a Master’s degree in Information Systems Technology and a strong foundation in full-stack development. Skilled in building scalable web applications and AI-integrated platforms using modern frameworks and cloud technologies. Experienced in working with React, TypeScript, Python, and containerized environments. Adept in implementing Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) capabilities, securing AI chatbot systems, and developing data-driven software products. Collaborative and committed to delivering efficient, secure, and user-centric software solutions.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, 2
positions.description:
● Developed and deployed RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot, implementing layered architecture and design patterns to improve maintainability and scalability
● Optimized database performance in PostgreSQL/MySQL by designing normalized schemas, adding indexes, and tuning queries; improved query execution speed by up to 5x for high-volume transactions
● Containerized enterprise applications with Docker and integrated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, enabling automated builds, testing, and deployments
● Implemented microservices architecture and event-driven workflows using Kafka and RabbitMQ, handling 1M+ messages/day and improving system throughput by 3x compared to synchronous designs
● Secured APIs with OAuth2 and Spring Security, enforced OWASP best practices, and integrated OpenAPI/Swagger documentation

positions.title: Senior Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
●	Spearheading the development of a data product platform using React, TypeScript, and Tailwind for the frontend, and Python for backend services.

●	Building and maintaining robust APIs and microservices; writing automated tests using Pytest to ensure code reliability and coverage.

●	Managing databases including Microsoft SQL Server and MongoDB, optimizing data queries and storage strategies for performance and scalability.

●	Enhancing platform features and resolving production issues to meet evolving client and business requirements.

●	Leading efforts on integrating AI chatbot functionality into the platform, focusing on implementing Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to improve relevance and contextual accuracy.

●	Implementing comprehensive data security measures for the chatbot, including access controls and sensitive data handling to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards.

●	Collaborating cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and QA to deliver iterative improvements and new capabilities in an agile development environment.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
●	Utilized cutting-edge technologies including ReactJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, Cypress, HTML, CSS on the frontend. Employed NodeJS, and MongoDB for robust backend functionality.

●	Actively collaborated with cross-functional development teams and product managers to conceptualize and implement innovative software solutions tailored to client needs.

●	Created and managed databases and implemented effective APIs, complemented by automated testing using Cypress to ensure high software quality and reliability.

●	Configured and maintained Azure DevOps pipelines for seamless building, testing, and deployment of code changes across production and staging environments. Automated containerized application deployment using Docker for consistency and reproducibility.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
●	Developed and implemented algorithms to enhance the FCC's Roll Call RF measurement and analysis system. These algorithms identified frequencies with signals across various frequency bands crucial for public safety communications.

●	Leveraged Python and key data science libraries, including Pandas, Seaborn, Matplotlib, Scikit-learn, and NumPy to analyze and visualize data effectively.

●	Utilized Roll Call data to assess signal presence at specific frequencies, developing code to summarize and automate the process for future Roll Call deployments.

●	Quickly gained proficiency in the Roll Call System, adapting to its complexities and nuances.

●	Built and evaluated four predictive models (Multiple Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree Classifier) to identify the most accurate model, highlighting data analysis and modeling capabilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Machine Learning · Python (Programming Language) · git · Predictive Modeling

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
positions.description:
●	Spearheaded the automation of 1187 form processing for federal agencies and payroll processors within the EverSign 1187 project, enhancing data management efficiency.

●	Designed and implemented a user-friendly web application utilizing C#, MS SQL, ASP.NET MVC, and Entity Framework to streamline 1187 database management, improving accessibility for end-users.

●	Developed a console application that efficiently retrieved and stored data from APIs into MS SQL, optimizing data retrieval and processing.

●	Collaborated closely with teams to ensure the smooth functioning of the EverSign 1187 project, fostering effective teamwork and communication.
positions.insights: Skills: Microsoft SQL Server · Entity Framework · ASP.NET MVC · C# · git

positions.title: Barista
positions.description:
● Demonstrated exceptional customer service skills by consistently providing personalized service to a diverse customer base, emphasizing effective communication and a customer-centric approach.

● Maintained efficiency in a fast-paced environment, handling multiple orders simultaneously and ensuring accurate and timely delivery of beverages, showcasing adaptability and the ability to work efficiently under pressure.

● Collaborated within a team environment, coordinating with fellow baristas and support staff to ensure seamless store operations and delivering a positive customer experience.

● Trained and onboarded new employees, emphasizing the ability to convey complex information effectively and support the growth and development of team members.

positions.title: Chef
positions.description:
● Demonstrated precision and attention to detail in crafting intricate sushi dishes, showcasing a commitment to quality and excellence in execution.

● Worked in a fast-paced and high-pressure environment, consistently meeting customer demand for freshly prepared sushi, highlighting adaptability and the ability to perform well under pressure.

● Collaborated closely with kitchen staff to coordinate meal preparation and delivery, fostering effective teamwork and communication skills.

● Utilized problem-solving skills to address challenges in maintaining food safety and quality standards, displaying a proactive approach to troubleshooting and resolution.

positions.title: Cashier Customer Service
positions.description:
● Developed strong interpersonal and communication skills through daily customer interactions, providing exceptional service and resolving inquiries promptly.

● Gained experience in maintaining accurate financial transactions, showcasing attention to detail and precision in record-keeping.

● Exhibited adaptability and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple tasks efficiently.

● Collaborated with team members to ensure smooth store operations, demonstrating teamwork and cooperation.

projects.title: Data Visualization
projects.description:
•	Worked with the Fatal Shooting database, used Tableau to create a dashboard and uploaded it to Tableau Public.
•	The visualization includes a hex map, bar chart, pie chart, and line chart
•	Created some calculated fields and used it in the visualization to add more meaning to the story.

projects.title: Visualize Python
projects.description:
•	Worked with movie database and created a program which calculates the profit for each movie, and stores them into a data frame, and ultimately display the data in both the data frame and as a bar graph.
•	From the API database, I used JSON to convert the database. Then, I used loc function from Pandas module to get what data I need.
